001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.clafer.common.Util;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PropLength extends Propagator<IntVar> {
017
018    private final IntVar[] chars;
019    private final IntVar length;
020    private final int terminator;
021
022    public PropLength(IntVar[] chars, IntVar length) {
023        this(chars, length, 0);
024    }
025
026    public PropLength(IntVar[] chars, IntVar length, int terminator) {
027        super(Util.cons(length, chars), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
028        this.chars = chars;
029        this.length = length;
030        this.terminator = terminator;
031    }
032
033    private boolean isLengthVar(int idx) {
034        return idx == 0;
035    }
036
037    private boolean isCharVar(int idx) {
038        return idx > 0;
039    }
040
041    private int getCharVarIndex(int idx) {
042        return idx - 1;
043    }
044
045    @Override
046    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
047        if (isLengthVar(vIdx)) {
048            return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
049        }
050        assert isCharVar(vIdx);
051        return IntEventType.all();
052    }
053
054    @Override
055    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
056        length.updateLowerBound(0, this);
057        length.updateUpperBound(chars.length, this);
058        for (int i = chars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
059            onCharRemove(i);
060        }
061        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
062            onCharInstantiate(i);
063        }
064        onLengthLB();
065        onLengthUB();
066    }
067
068    @Override
069    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
070        if (isLengthVar(idxVarInProp)) {
071            if (IntEventType.isInclow(mask) || IntEventType.isInstantiate(mask)) {
072                onLengthLB();
073            }
074            if (IntEventType.isDecupp(mask) || IntEventType.isInstantiate(mask)) {
075                onLengthUB();
076            }
077        } else {
078            assert isCharVar(idxVarInProp);
079            int id = getCharVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
080            if (onCharRemove(id)) {
081                onLengthLB();
082            }
083            if (onCharInstantiate(id)) {
084                onLengthUB();
085            }
086        }
087    }
088
089    private void onLengthLB() throws ContradictionException {
090        for (int i = 0; i < length.getLB(); i++) {
091            chars[i].removeValue(terminator, this);
092        }
093    }
094
095    private void onLengthUB() throws ContradictionException {
096        for (int i = length.getUB(); i < chars.length; i++) {
097            chars[i].instantiateTo(terminator, this);
098        }
099    }
100
101    private boolean onCharRemove(int i) throws ContradictionException {
102        return !chars[i].contains(terminator)
103                && length.updateLowerBound(i + 1, this);
104    }
105
106    private boolean onCharInstantiate(int i) throws ContradictionException {
107        return chars[i].isInstantiatedTo(terminator)
108                && length.updateUpperBound(i, this);
109    }
110
111    @Override
112    public ESat isEntailed() {
113        if (length.getLB() > chars.length || length.getUB() < 0) {
114            return ESat.FALSE;
115        }
116        int leftMostTerminator = chars.length;
117        // A possible terminator before leftMostTerminator.
118        boolean earlierTerminator = false;
119        // Characters after leftMostTerminator are all termiators.
120        boolean suffixTerminators = true;
121        int rightMostCharacterTerminator = -1;
122        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
123            if (chars[i].contains(terminator)) {
124                if (chars[i].isInstantiatedTo(terminator)) {
125                    if (leftMostTerminator == chars.length) {
126                        leftMostTerminator = i;
127                    }
128                    if (i < length.getLB()) {
129                        return ESat.FALSE;
130                    }
131                }
132                earlierTerminator |= leftMostTerminator == chars.length;
133            } else {
134                rightMostCharacterTerminator = i;
135                if (i >= length.getUB()) {
136                    return ESat.FALSE;
137                }
138            }
139            suffixTerminators &= leftMostTerminator == chars.length || chars[i].isInstantiatedTo(terminator);
140        }
141        if (length.previousValue(leftMostTerminator + 1) < 0) {
142            return ESat.FALSE;
143        }
144        if (length.nextValue(rightMostCharacterTerminator) > leftMostTerminator) {
145            return ESat.FALSE;
146        }
147        if (!earlierTerminator && suffixTerminators && length.isInstantiatedTo(leftMostTerminator)) {
148            return ESat.TRUE;
149        }
150        return isCompletelyInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
151    }
152
153    @Override
154    public String toString() {
155        return "length(" + Arrays.toString(chars) + ") = " + length;
156    }
157}
